notes.title: Release Update 1.0.0. End of early access! Release RIGHT NOW!!!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

Today I want to express my deepest gratitude to each of you for becoming a part of our project! Your support, your feedback, and your loyalty have helped us create a game that we are truly proud of.

When we started this journey, all we had was an idea and a strong desire to bring it to life. We knew there would be many challenges ahead, but every day we worked tirelessly to make our game better. We spent countless nights solving complex technical issues, discussing every detail of the gameplay, and creating a world that would capture your attention.

This project became more than just work for us. It was a challenge to ourselves, a drive to prove that dreams can become reality. Each member of our team (me and my wife =)) poured their heart and soul into this game, and thanks to you, it came alive.

We are thrilled that we were able to give you hours of engaging gameplay, vibrant emotions, and unforgettable moments. Your reviews (not too many on Steam) and stories about how our game has become a part of your lives inspire us to keep moving forward and create even more amazing projects.

Thank you for believing in us and supporting us! You are our most valuable players, and none of this would have been possible without you. Keep playing, sharing your experiences, and helping us get better!

Due to the fact that the game has not been a commercial success, we have decided to reduce the price to a minimum in order to make it more accessible for more people to play and share their opinions. Thank you gamers, again!!!

With respect,
Danny Deffoe, The Developer of "Escape from the Nursing Home".

[b]Added[/b]
[list]
[*] New items.
[*] New player buffs and debuffs.
[*] Many of new diseases.
[*] Map event system.
[*] Few customization items.
[*] NEW ESCAPES!!!
[*] Detailed disease description.
[*] So many graphic changes and improvements.
[/list]

[b]Fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed many visual bugs.
[*] Fixed some rare bugs. 
[*] Fixed many any bugs)
[/list]

Now I will be engaged in a new, better and more interesting project! However, "Escape from the Nursing Home" is not abandoned, and I will release an update as I have time or when it is needed!

Thank you for being with us!

notes.title: Update 0.8.1. Speedrun rewards!
notes.content:
It's been a long time, grandchildrens! How did you celebrate the new Year?

Rewards, new achievements, new character customization elements and a bunch of fixes! That's what brought us the first big update this year.

Now you can get a reward for different events that you can put on your character. These events will happen several times a year. We will release the news with an information of the first reward soon.

You can also get a reward for some hidden events in the game. And of course, the reward and achievement can be obtained for the speedrun of each of the escapes! By the way, there is now a visual reward for getting all the achievements in the game!

[i]P.S. If you have previously completed any escape speedrun, rewards will be given to you as soon as you log into the game.[/i]

notes.title: Dev diary #3. Get to know "Stange pills"!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
A few weeks of development have passed, bringing us closer to the release. We have finished or transferred all the mechanics to the final stage of development.
During this time, we came up with a great idea, so now there are two new items in "Escape from the Nursing Home" - "Strange tablet" and "Strange pill". 
So, what is it and what is it eaten with?

Both items can spawn all over the map. However, tablets have a lower chance of spawn, while pills have a slightly greater chance.
Why you have to look for them and use them, and why do pills spawn more often?

 - The "Strange pill" when used allows you to get a buff / debuff associated with degeneration of needs (as well as stamina or the speed of movement of the character). 
This can be extremely useful if you don't have time to sleep or eat, or you just want to get a movement speed buff to steal something quickly and unnoticeably. But be careful, such a great opportunity to gain an advantage can also have the opposite effect.

 - The "Strange tablet" when used allows you to get strong, and even extremely strong (with a small chance) buff or the same strong debuff. The effects that the tablet can give you will serve as an extremely pleasant bonus that will help you throughout the rest of the game. Or it will provide you with a debuff that will greatly spoil your immediate plans. 
Does everyone want to feel young? You know, it's kinda - stamina does not go away or the chronic disease will miraculously disappear. This tablet can give you the opportunity!
However, it's clearly not the best idea to swallow pills without a name. Still, a potential heart attack is a serious matter, and also you would not like to get pants dirty after taking a tablet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44378281/a89cf89b6e562d20b658201d9a2cd5725a6e6910.jpg[/img]

*consult a specialist before use.

notes.title: Dev diary #2. Small balance changing and playing sport!
notes.content:
Today I will tell you about a new mechanic - playing sports.

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]

Based on the results of analysis of players' walkthrough the demo version, we decided to change the system of "fatigue" and stamina.
In the game, among other needs, there is a need to rest. It is difficult for us to stand on our feet for many hours, and the main character of our game is an oldster, it is even more difficult for him. So, sometimes you need to sit down and rest. You can relax at lunch, during a nap, play chess or just sit on a bench.

So, what does the need to rest affect? Oddly enough, to stamina. And specifically on the "length" of the stamina bar. It can also be called a "stamina maximum". For example, if you have not rested for a long time, you will be able to walk a shorter distance before your stamina runs out. (Not yours, you're not an old man... probably...)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44378281/569b46f687d1f5c1060672aa06eb783648d7c523.jpg[/img]
[i]-Stamina bar[/i]

Moments that I personally did not like when watching the demo walkthrough by other people:
[olist]
[*] The stamina bar was too small when "fatigue" value is zero. So small that you can only take a few steps.
[*] Slow stamina regeneration. If you have spent all the stamina, then it regenerates too slowly. This is especially noticeable when the "fatigue" need value is full. (Stamina bar length is maximum)
[*] Fast "fatigue" decrease, even with slow walking.
[/olist]
We decided to improve it:
[olist]
[*] Raise the minimum stamina at full "fatigue" value (the stamina bar has become longer).
[*] Stamina regenerates exponentially. So, if you have a VERY long stamina bar (for various reasons), you will not have to wait long for it to be refill.
[*] Limit the maximum value of "fatigue". (more on this later)
[*] Greatly reduce the "fatigue" value degeneration when walking. And reduce the fatigue value degeneration when walking fast.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44378281/f2b2b14d17f657d52afc826f1328599c39b462f3.jpg[/img]
[i]-Needs and maximum lock fatigue[/i]

[h1]The mechanics of sports.[/h1]

As I wrote earlier, we have limited the maximum value of "fatigue". In the new version, at the start player will have 50% of the maximum "fatigue" value available. Thus, the player will start with less stamina than before the changes. But as I wrote earlier, the degeneration of the "fatigue" value will be less, so it will lead to a more comfortable game at the beginning. But that's not all!

You have the opportunity to maximize the "fatigue" value. This will make it possible to have rest less often, and walk longer without a break (The greater the value of "fatigue" - the longer the stamina bar).
So to increase the maximum value of "fatigue", you only need to exercise regularly in the gym.
Cycling is just as important as strength training. But don't forget to eat healthy food!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44378281/9510b1ab2eb9485aa4ffdabef8fe40736143cf6d.jpg[/img]
[i]-Oldsters ride the stationary bikes[/i]


[i]*Before playing sports, consult with a specialist![/i]
